title: shelf.yml — openshelf shelf manifest (shelf-spec v0)
description: Manifest of an openshelf shelf. A manifest that is missing, unparseable, or fails this schema is a config-error: no operation runs against the shelf before the manifest validates. Fields reserved for M1 (agents, provenance) are accepted by the schema in v0 and ignored by single-mode tooling.

spec_version.description: Version of shelf-spec this shelf declares conformance to. Semver, major.minor with optional patch. v0 shelves declare "0.1".

mode.description: single: one client/agent writes at a time (the whole v0 surface). multi: shared multi-agent shelf — reserved for M1; v0 validators report it as not yet normative.

name.description: Human-readable shelf name. Shown by shelf_info and normally mirrored as the INDEX H1.

profile.description: Rule profile. memory: episodes with frontmatter, ledger and policy expected (memshelf lineage). document: plain markdown documents, no frontmatter requirements (docshelf lineage). Default: document.

docs_root.description: Directory holding the shelf content, relative to the shelf root. Default: docs. May be nested (e.g. DOCS/markdown). Must not be absolute and must not contain '..'.

categories.description: Declared categories (subdirectories of docs_root). Empty or absent = implicit: categories are whatever directories exist, and documents directly under docs_root are allowed. When declared explicitly, an undeclared category directory is a spec violation.

path.description: Index file path relative to the shelf root. Default: INDEX.md.

generated_by.description: Who renders the index. docshelf-mcp: the reference implementation (its generator footer marker is required). external: some other generator (no marker requirement). manual: hand-maintained — the only value that exempts the shelf from the 'INDEX is never hand-edited' rule. Default: docshelf-mcp.

ledger.description: Shelve journal contract (memory profile SHOULD have one).

path.description: Ledger path relative to the shelf root. Default: ledger.tsv.
Policy path relative to the shelf root. Default: POLICY.md.

extra_dirs.description: Additional non-markdown directories that legitimately belong to the shelf (e.g. binary sidecars like compressed PDF originals). Declared so validators know they are intentional.

agents.description: RESERVED for M1 (multi mode): agent registry. Accepted and ignored by v0 single-mode tooling; validators flag it as reserved in multi mode.

path.description: Path of the agent registry file relative to the shelf root. Default: agents.yml.

provenance.description: RESERVED for M1 (multi mode): provenance stamps for every write. Accepted and ignored by v0 single-mode tooling.

dir.description: Directory of provenance stamps relative to the shelf root. Default: provenance/.

required.description: Whether every write must carry a provenance stamp. In multi mode this is normatively true (M1).
